schema_version.description: Standard version this record conforms to.

taxonomy_version.description: Version of taxonomy.yaml used for failure_classes.

summary.description: Neutral 1–3 sentence factual summary. No editorializing.

date.description: Date the incident occurred or was first publicly disclosed (YYYY-MM-DD).

incident_type.description: incident = realized harm in the wild; hazard = demonstrated PoC / near-miss that could plausibly cause harm (OECD-style).

status.description: Report maturity (NTSB-style). 'disputed' facts are handled via confidence, not status.

confidence.description: reported=single source; corroborated=multiple independent; confirmed=first-party/vendor/court-confirmed; disputed=facts contested.

severity.description: Impact band. See severity_rationale for justification; do NOT infer a numeric score.

system.description: The stack involved. Name systems factually as data; do not editorialize.

framework.description: e.g. LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Code, custom, n/a

vendor.description: Operating org/vendor of the deployed system, if applicable.

autonomy_level.description: How much the agent could act without human approval at time of incident.

failure_classes.description: Ordered chain of failure classes; the causal sequence. First SHOULD equal primary_failure_class.

subclass.description: Subclass from taxonomy.yaml under this class.

attack_vector.description: For security-relevant incidents: how the failure was induced (VERIS action.vector analogue).

causation.description: MIT AI Risk Repository causal dimensions.

trigger.description: What set it off — described as a (near-)reproducible input/condition where the public source allows.

root_cause.description: The underlying cause. Blameless: systemic, not personal.

amount_usd_max.description: Upper bound if reported as a range.

user_harm.description: Harm categories from arXiv 2501.17037. Never identify individuals beyond public sources.

scope.description: Breadth, e.g. 'single user', '~1M extension installs', '30 orgs targeted'.

at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp or date, if known.

external_ids.description: Cross-references to other databases (de-dup, not clone).

mappings.description: External security-framework cross-references, derived from failure_classes via schema/framework-mappings.yaml.

owasp_llm.description: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) ids.

owasp_agentic.description: OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations threat ids.

sources.description: REQUIRED. ≥1 public, linkable source. No rumors. Structured for permanence and citability.

type.description: primary-research=the researcher writeup; vendor-response=the named vendor's reply (supports neutrality/right-of-reply).

archive_url.description: Wayback/permanent snapshot. Auto-generated in CI if absent (REQ-C5).

evidence_assessments.description: Optional claim-level provenance: how well specific statements in this record are supported by its own sources. Does not replace the record-level `confidence`.

machine_export.description: Optional hints that shape the stampede/costbomb export projections. If absent, export derives sensible defaults.

replayable.description: True if trigger can be shaped into a scenario/seed.

failureClass.description: Top-level failure class. See taxonomy.yaml for subclasses and cairn alignment.

field_path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the assessed value in this record, e.g. /root_cause or /blast_radius/cost/amount_usd. Must resolve; the validator checks it.

claim.description: The specific statement being assessed, in neutral words.

evidence_status.description: direct=stated by a cited source; corroborated=stated by two or more independent cited sources; inferred=analyst reasoning from cited facts, not stated by a source; unknown=sources do not establish it; disputed=cited sources or a named party contest it.

source_urls.description: Supporting sources. Each entry must equal a `url` in this record's `sources[]` exactly; the validator checks it.

analyst_note.description: Reasoning behind the status. Required for inferred and disputed.

reviewer.description: Optional pseudonymous reviewer handle. Never a legal name or email address.

uncertainty.description: What remains unestablished and what evidence would settle it.
